ops.d: List every databaseAccounts in the subscription.
List the databaseAccounts in a resource group.

features.t: Database accounts (create, get, list, delete) over ARM
Network rules (selected networks) and private endpoints
x: virtualNetworkRules (subnet must carry the Microsoft.AzureCosmosDB service endpoint, enabled for you), ipRules (valid IPv4 addresses/CIDRs), isVirtualNetworkFilterEnabled and publicNetworkAccess are real validated ARM state, and private endpoints (privatelink.documents.azure.com) with approve/reject are real control-plane resources. Data-plane requests are ENFORCED against ipRules / virtualNetworkRules (subnet needs the Microsoft.AzureCosmosDB service endpoint) / publicNetworkAccess=Disabled / private endpoints for a caller that declares its network identity with x-vyomi-source-ip / x-vyomi-source-subnet / x-vyomi-private-endpoint headers (403 Forbidden otherwise); a caller with no declared identity is only blocked by publicNetworkAccess=Disabled, since the simulator has no real source network. The account is named by x-vyomi-account / Host, or is the only Cosmos account.

features.t: Data Explorer: databases, containers and documents over the native Cosmos DB REST (SQL/Core API) data plane
x: The Cosmos data-plane store is a single keyspace shared by every Cosmos account in this Vyomi environment (no per-account partitioning) — a database id created under one account is visible from any other account's Data Explorer.

features.t: SQL query (SELECT) over the Cosmos data plane
x: Covers a pragmatic SELECT subset: projection (incl. SELECT VALUE), TOP n, WHERE combining comparisons/IN/CONTAINS/STARTSWITH/ENDSWITH with a single logical operator throughout (AND-only or OR-only — mixed or parenthesized boolean expressions are not parsed), ORDER BY one field, OFFSET/LIMIT, and a top-level COUNT/VALUE COUNT aggregate; joins, subqueries, GROUP BY, other aggregate/system functions and stored procedures are not implemented.

properties.consistencyPolicy is ENFORCED at the ARM contract level (defaultConsistencyLevel must be one of the 5 real values; BoundedStaleness requires maxStalenessPrefix in [10, 2147483647] and maxIntervalInSeconds in [5, 86400], same range Azure validates) — but every data-plane read in Vyomi is already strongly consistent, regardless of the configured level.

Add region and Manual Failover are ENFORCED for real: properties.locations is validated (unique region names, a 0-based gap-free failoverPriority sequence) and failoverPriorityChange really reassigns which region is failoverPriority 0. Vyomi still has one logical region underneath, so an added region never gets its own separately provisioned data-plane copy, and Service-Managed (automatic) Failover is an honest 'Not simulated' gap — Vyomi never triggers a failover on its own.

properties.backupPolicy is ENFORCED at the ARM contract level (backupPolicy.type, the Periodic interval/retention/redundancy ranges, the Continuous tier enum, and Azure's one-way Continuous-to-Periodic migration block all match the real API).

features.t: Resource locks (Microsoft.Authorization/locks), scoped to the database account
x: Lock create/list/delete are real Microsoft.Authorization/locks over ARM at resource, resource-group and subscription scope (CanNotDelete/ReadOnly, name and notes validated); this blade manages the locks scoped to this Cosmos DB account only and has no scope switch. A resource-group or subscription lock really blocks writes and deletes of everything under it with 409 ScopeLocked (core/azure_arm_ext_core.py lock_conflict), but a lock set directly on a Cosmos DB account is stored and listed only: it does not block writes or deletes of the Cosmos DB account itself.

features.t: Identity (system and user assigned managed identity)
x: System assigned managed identity mints a stable principalId/tenantId (core/azure_arm_core.py _apply_identity), persists across PATCH and clears on 'None'. User assigned identities are real: references to Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities are resolved, an unknown reference is rejected with 400 ResourceNotFound. The identity is not used to authorize anything beyond being the subject of a role assignment on Access control (IAM).

Only console/SDK-triggered ARM mutations made since the simulation booted are recorded (no historical backfill). The timespan picker is ENFORCED (narrowing it to e.g. 'Last hour' really drops older events via eventTimestamp ge on the query), but severity/category filtering is not modelled, and `caller` is a fixed placeholder identity rather than the real signed-in principal.

features.t: Access control (IAM): role assignments and built-in role definitions over ARM
x: Role assignments and role definitions are real ARM resources (Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments, roleDefinitions). The Role assignments list is now ENFORCED scoped to this account (plus its subscription/resource-group ancestors, matching real Azure's inherited-access view) instead of the whole subscription; Roles stays subscription-wide, which matches real Azure (built-in role definitions are listed tenant-wide too). 'Check access' / 'My access' evaluation is still not modelled — Vyomi never denies a console action based on a role assignment.

Month-to-date real-Azure cost, list price per month and money saved are derived from the shared Cost Management engine over this account's ARM record (account-level list price; per-container RU/s and storage metering is not modelled).

A real search service, index, data source and indexer are created through Microsoft.Search, but Vyomi indexers only read Blob data: running the indexer on a cosmosdb data source ends in transientFailure with that message. Pulling Cosmos documents into an index is not implemented.

features.t: Change feed (A-IM: Incremental feed) and Azure Functions cosmosDBTrigger
x: Latest-version mode only: each create/upsert/replace stamps a monotonically increasing _lsn; reading with `A-IM: Incremental feed` returns documents above the If-None-Match continuation (304 when none, x-ms-max-item-count honoured). Deletes are not in the feed (as in real latest-version mode); there is a single logical feed per container (no feed ranges / partition-key-range ids, no all-versions-and-deletes mode).
Rules are validated (at most 10; scheme://host origins, *.domain wildcards, methods, maxAgeInSeconds) and stored on the account. The Vyomi data plane does not add Access-Control headers from them.

Provisioning is validated (NoSQL non-serverless accounts, size Cosmos.D4s/D8s/D16s, 1-5 instances) and the endpoint is derived. There is no integrated cache: requests through the gateway endpoint are not served.

The key URI shape, the existence of its Key Vault in this subscription and a managed identity are required; a customer-managed key cannot be removed. The key is looked up in the Key Vault keys data plane (400 KeyVaultKeyNotFound / KeyVaultKeyDisabled); that store is one keyspace shared by all vaults, so the lookup is by key name, not per vault, and data is not re-encrypted.

features.t: Scale: request-unit consumption from measured requests
x: RU charges are MODELLED from each measured request's size using Microsoft's published cost model (1 KB point read = 1 RU, 1 KB write ~ 5 RU) - not metered by a real RU engine. A manual or autoscale offer on a database (shared) or container (ARM sqlDatabases[/containers]/throughputSettings/default, validated: manual >= 400 step 100, autoscale max >= 1000 step 1000) IS enforced with 429 RequestRateTooLarge + x-ms-retry-after-ms over a trailing one-second window using that modelled charge (autoscale max is the limit; no step scaling, no per-partition 10k RU/s limit); each response carries x-ms-request-charge. Consumption is account-level (not split per container).
